About version updates: "You enable Dependabot version updates by checking a dependabot.yml configuration file into your repository." "When Dependabot identifies an outdated dependency, it raises a pull request". Pages sit under the dependabot root.

Carried from prior review (claim unchanged). Lesson now ties drift to pub without a lock file. Flutter docs: pubspec.lock "ensures that every developer on your team, and your build servers, use the exact same package versions"; flutter pub upgrade takes "the latest versions allowed by your pubspec.yaml constraints". NuGet is no longer the example (NuGet "looks for the lowest applicable version").

Carried from prior review (claim unchanged). Options reference: default-days is "Default cooldown period for dependencies without specific rules (optional)." The whole cooldown block is optional ("If not specified, Dependabot applies a default cooldown of 3 days"), so 7 is a repository choice. The trade-off half is reasoning.

issues.text: New in round 2 (changed text). I follow the range gloss, but the `^` in "a `^` constraint" is never said to be how pub writes a range; I infer it only from "for example". q6 is built on this `^` constraint.
issues.quote: with pub, for example, a `^` constraint lets resolution pick a newer allowed release
issues.fix: Make the link explicit in a few words: "with pub, for example, a `^` constraint (pub's way of writing a range) lets resolution pick…".
